title: Hex mapping, for demo - do not merge
body:
This is a build attempting to create review app demonstrating hex mapping.

**Note:** It is NOT intended to merge this into `develop`

issues.title: Need to implement `Save Geometry`
issues.body:
We're allowing users to edit a geometry.  But, we still need to implement `Save`.

We `eventually` have to edit the live object in the `json-editor`.  But, it's significant that we're storing the GeoJSON in `hiddenStore`.  When users to `modifyForSave` it takes this GeoJSON and stores it.  If we _slide_ the edited value into there, we'll store the new geometry.
